_comment: FICTIONAL demo household. Single source of truth for the three sample PDFs (backend/app/docs/generate.py). Whole US dollars, 2026 dollars. Names, SSNs, addresses and accounts are invented. Keys starting with an underscore are comments.
_wages_note: wages are gross pay before the pre-tax 401(k) deferral; W-2 box 1 = wages - pretax_401k (115,500 and 85,500).

income._comment: ordinary_dividends is Form 1040 line 3b and INCLUDES the qualified dividends (line 3a).

holdings.name: Sample US Total Market Index Fund
Sample US Large Cap Index Fund
Sample US Small Cap Index Fund
Sample US Mid Cap Index Fund

retirement_401k._comment: Contributions printed on the statement are each person's pretax_401k above, so they are not repeated here.

not_in_documents._comment: Not on any generated document: the UI asks for these or estimates them. Ages are the taxpayer's (the brief gives a single household age).

intentional_discrepancy.description: The brokerage statement prints one holding (SDIN) $1 lower than its true value, a rounding difference. The six printed holdings add up to $149,999 while the stated total value stays $150,000, so the parser flags brokerage_total_value (medium confidence) and every other field in all three documents passes its cross-checks.
